mods.name: Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression (STAGES + RESKINS)
mods.summary: Framework and progression for the step-by-step corruption of Miao Ying (Cathay) over six stages plus a stage 6+ with a birth mechanic; changes affect character, body, armor/shoes and traits. Also a diplomacy mechanic ("Foreign Dickplomacy") toward Slaanesh/Chaos factions, mainly N'Kari, as well as balance adjustments ("Corruption Adaptation"). The stage mods can be used individually and are pure reskins without this framework; the LL downloads now only redirect to the Steam collection.

playAs.note: Corruption stages 1-6, 6+ with birth trait tiers

loadOrder.note: The progression framework must be above the stage/reskin mods in the mod list, otherwise a crash at startup. Which campaign image appears depends on which reskin is higher. The included 'Corruption Adaptation' has no load order requirement, but should sit below the progression framework.

knownIssues: After Miao is confederated, her name disappears from the next turn on (names only apply within the culture group); no fix planned
Diplomacy mechanic (defeats against N'Kari) only works with manually fought battles; autoresolve does not trigger the events

notes.text: Central support server for the Lazy corruption ecosystem: invite https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk (alternatively https://discord.com/invite/lazyicarus). For errors, first read #faq, then post in #help; requires li_log.txt (generated automatically in the game folder) and the current script_log_xxx.txt (needs the Lua Console mod, Steam 2791799449, before loading a save). The authors Rat of the Lake (#lake-tales) and Kerberos use the same server; role 'Kerberos's Azazel Realm' under 'Channels & Roles' gives update pings.

Lazy's progression framework sits above the stage/reskin mods (mod list: framework first, otherwise CTD). Stage mods can be used individually; without the framework they are pure reskins, with the framework the gameplay changes come in. The LL pages for Miao (23878), Morathi (23925) and Katarin (23966) now only redirect to Steam Workshop items (the Workshop version is called !li_progression_framework_workshop, formerly !!li_progression_framework.pack, 'name may change'). The framework is described on the Miao page (page: 'Framework for gameplay progressive corruption of Miao Ying'). Other mods that set 'requires li mod' (e.g. Corrupted Landmarks, Additional corrupted Buildings) depend on it.

Progression guides and framework documentation for Lazy's mods: https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/Lewdhammer_Wiki ; pages 'Morathi', 'Morathi_Lore#Masque_Side_Progression', 'Katarin', 'How_to_use_Progression_Framework#Usage' (for modders).
With Lazy's mods, the topmost reskin in the load order determines which campaign image appears (Miao).

Russian translation packs (e.g. Community Beastmen, LL 43659) belong ABOVE the original in the mod list (higher priority = loads later). For the Alarielle translation (LL 43740), the instruction reads 'before the main mod' (ambiguous).

For Valkia (LL 24004), the Variant Selector should be below Valkia in the mod order; for Ensign Loi reskins (LL 27230), the reskin must be above the Corrupted Compendium. Mod managers show a harmless asset conflict with HuaJS258's Cathay Roster or Blushing Moon for the Loi variants.

Kerberos only enables flags/loading screens (LL 41124) and the 'Slaanesh UI theme' (Steam 3304325611) from corruption stage 4 (Miao) or stage 5 (Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom); otherwise duplicate UI elements are possible in the Alarielle mod.

notes.text: Delete Corrupted Landmarks (Steam 3474483873) from the data folder before subscribing, otherwise problems. Mod no longer has hard dependencies, detects Lazy's Miao/Kat progression itself. Load order doesn't matter.
